property_summary: For any actor and any amounts, every call to addToBalance with value amount increases getBalance(actor) by that amount — even after previous successful deposits; the mutant permanently locks after the first guarded call, so its second addToBalance reverts and the balance is not increased.
change_summary: Remove the lock release so the contract permanently locks after the first guarded call, making all subsequent addToBalance calls revert instead of updating balances.
